puzzle.hint: The promised moment of reckoning that doubters think will never stand
puzzle.arabicVerse: وَمَآ أَظُنُّ ٱلسَّاعَةَ قَآئِمَةًۭ وَلَئِن رُّدِدتُّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّى لَأَجِدَنَّ خَيْرًۭا مِّنْهَا مُنقَلَبًۭا
puzzle.verse: 18:36 - And I do not think the Hour will occur. And even if I should be brought back to my Lord, I will surely find better than this as a return."
